name: azure-devsecops
description: Meridian Launch Systems demo monorepo — npm workspace root for the apps tree.
//workspaces: Explicit list, not a glob: apps/vuln-lab is deliberately excluded. It pins known-vulnerable dependency versions for the L10 self-healing showpiece, and root hoisting would resolve those pins to patched versions and neuter the seeded CVEs. It also must never enter a deployed app's dependency graph. vuln-lab keeps its own standalone package.json + lockfile and is installed and audited on its own.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
